description: Generate a textured 3D mesh (GLB) from a text prompt or a reference image URL. In text mode an AI art-director first refines your prompt into an optimized single-subject spec for higher mesh quality. Renders inline in an interactive 3D viewer.

image_url.description: Optional http(s) URL to a reference image to reconstruct directly.

prompt.description: Description of the single object to model.

name: mesh_forge
title: Generate a 3D mesh (art-directed)
